results.title: Global trends and hotspots in Asian Art research from 1997 ...
results.content: # Global trends and hotspots in Asian Art research from 1997 to 2023: a bibliometric analysis and visualization study. illustrates the three-field plot based on the Bibliometrix R package, which describes the relationships between countries, institutions, and journals of Asian art research publications. This suggests that studying cultural identity and diversity in Asian art from a globalization perspective will remain a scholarly focus and is likely to become a key research area in the future. It examined the characteristics of publications, countries, institutions, scholars, journals, and highly co-cited literature, as well as conducted keyword clustering and timeline analyses of Asian art research to predict future trends. In the future, comparing Asian art research with that of the United States or Europe could reveal both similarities and differences in artistic creation and scholarship across diverse cultural contexts, thus contributing to a cross-cultural understanding of global art history.
